name: The Hot Sauce Festival
source:
The Main character goes to the annual hot sauce festival and tries out some hot sauces while also meeting a few vendors along the way.

[from [url=https://axxisproductions.itch.io/the-hot-sauce-festival]itch.io[/url]]
